content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-l03-crbr0_xm/report.rdl

Add a page footer with 'Page X of Y'.

I added a page footer with "Page X of Y" to the report. It shows the current page number and total page count, e.g. "Page 1 of 3".

The footer is 0.3 inches tall, and the text box inside it is 6.5 inches wide, which matches the printable width between the 1-inch side margins. The text is left-aligned, since I didn't set an alignment. Right-aligning it would be a quick follow-up.

The validator passes with no errors. The warnings it reports were already in the report and are unrelated to this change: two unused data sources (LegacySQL and ScratchPowerQuery), the DateFrom and DateTo parameters typed as String rather than DateTime, and a `Utilization` field in DataSet1 that the query doesn't appear to return.
